title: The Daily Working of Light and the Two Faces
description: T79 describes how light comes in and works through the soul: the soul carries the whole company of self-loving arrangements within her own substance, and any work of purification has to happen there. The soul that comes in under the Lord's ordering receives nourishment day by day, and by that daily reception she habitually purifies, cleanses, and washes forth the darkness that had been mingled into her — not by seizure but by feeding. T80 names the two faces shown forth in the rational: the face of love, where the Lord's love has been received and the inmost turns outward as beauty joined to longing; and the face the soul wears while the love-of-strife is still in it, the proprium's contention being refined, until only one face remains.
